long_biography.plain_text:
Gabriele Volpi played water polo for Pro Recco while earning his living as a factory worker. He left competitive sport for steadier employment, working as a pharmaceutical sales representative before entering African shipping and logistics. Decades later, he returned to his former club as its owner and president.

His backing helped Pro Recco win repeated national and European titles during a long period of success. He also acquired Spezia after its financial collapse, supporting the football club's climb from the amateur divisions to Serie A. Both sporting investments eventually passed to new owners, ending his direct involvement with the clubs.
